question: Should OpenClaw require live Cloudflare Sandbox proof before merging this Cloudchamber detector PR, or accept the reporter-provided cgroup sample plus regression tests?
rationale: The code shape is narrow, but this external PR changes compatibility-sensitive container classification and lacks after-fix proof from a real Cloudflare Sandbox environment.

options.title: Require Live Cloudflare Proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output or logs from Cloudflare Sandbox showing /proc/1/cgroup and the patched detector classifying it as a container before merge.

options.title: Accept Reporter-Sample Risk
options.body: Maintainers can land based on the reported cgroup sample and regression tests while owning the risk that real Cloudflare variants differ.

options.title: Consolidate Detectors First
options.body: Pause this PR and replace it with a detector consolidation plus the same Cloudchamber matcher if duplicate detector maintenance is the bigger concern.

recommendation.title: Require Live Cloudflare Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output or logs from Cloudflare Sandbox showing /proc/1/cgroup and the patched detector classifying it as a container before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter merged the closest Fly detector precedent and is the strongest available routing candidate for proof-sufficiency and compatibility judgment on this detector surface.
